entry_points.text: Setup assigns priority and maps read, write, flush, discard, zero, erase, zone; append uses extended trailer; unknown or zone without support rejected; discard builds ranges with fast path and warning.
Add failure kicks, stops hardware queue only on space exhaustion, unwinds mappings, and translates error; memory shortage leaves queue running to avoid stall.
Batch groups consecutive requests by queue with prep failures requeued; commit performs deferred kick for one context.

Personality publishes teardown and zoned-only reporting; multiqueue includes mapping spreading counts with affinity and batch completion releasing resources; attributes form null-terminated group with visibility.

Identifier claims block class; tables share set with zoned only modern; driver links to probe, remove, config, freeze, restore, reset; init creates workqueue, reserves major, registers; exit reverses.

exports.text: Queue API submits scatters, offers inbound buffers, retrieves completions with optional context, controls callbacks with prepare and poll, and prepares, issues, or combines notifications.
Config uses typed reads gated by feature, byte writes, delegated queue find; setup publishes driver-ok with sync, break-all uses list lock, reset breaks first, plus register and unregister.
DMA size comes from custom hooks or parent when mapping required, else unbounded; mapping need follows inverted platform-access polarity with Xen exception.

hazards.text: Space stops queue, memory leaves it running; broken suppresses poll and notify; zero erase params and invalid limits fail; cache write assumes configurable else bug.
Duplicate driver-ok warns; broken must be visible before ready and reset; coherent release needs sleepable so atomic defers; id lookups return unreferenced pointers not to outlive lock.
Additional cross-dossier helpers for container lookup, error pointers, mutexes, DMA-coherent allocation, and list traversal are used but owned elsewhere.

invariants.text: Status maps success, unsupported, zone-resource with others to I/O error; context maps to queue via device; submission orders header, payload, trailer; handles resolve via container.
32/64-bit conversion picks little when modern negotiated or legacy host is little, else big; feature checks validate then test; bad constant fails build, runtime warns once.
Empty skips mapping; otherwise inline plus paged tables chain by segment count and release only when present; completion reads final trailer byte; barriers use light ordering when allowed.

Zone reports cap by capacity and hardware with halving retry via sync read and parse start, length, pointer, type under mutex with type-specific pointer rules; zoned needs granularity, pow2 size, covering append; unknown model, type, or state fails.

Capacity rereads host, rounds, announces resize and notifies; change only schedules work; init forces one queue without multiqueue, rejects zero, clamps, splits poll queues with names, locks, no double free; tunables persist.

Identity pairs host id with sysfs empty on error; geometry prefers host triple else defaults under mutex; names add base-26 suffix with minor shift; cache follows writeback when configurable else flush; detachment and overflow fail.

Search by terminal or host id returns unreferenced, by devt or queue acquires reference, else null; console means handler, rproc needs build plus id, multiport reflects bit; inbound reuses cache, outbound registers singly.

locks.text: Device mutex guards late-after-removal paths; each virtqueue has its own spinlock.
Polling holds its queue lock across full drain and restart of stopped queues then returns count.
Global lock guards device and console lists; dedicated lock guards deferred DMA-free splice.

state_machines.text: Queue ops dispatch over split and packed each normal and in-order, fatal otherwise; value and void forms share selection.

Requests go setup, mapping, start, IRQ-safe locked enqueue, notify outside, drain with suppress, rearm, race check, restart, to release, writeback, translation; batched by queue with flush on change; failures divert to cleanup.

Probe allocates index, state, depth, tag set, limits, cache, disk, capacity, then driver-ok before queue use; removal, freeze, reset quiesce, unpublish, reset, clear pointer, delete queues; freeze drains and nulls; restore recreates.
Allocation drains deferred frees, returns for page-backed, else DMA-coherent with ref or heap; release drops pages, frees heap, defers coherent when atomic; reclamation splices under lock then frees.

structs.text: Per-queue pairs handle, lock, 16-char name, cacheline aligned; device holds mutex, device, disk, tag set, work, index, counts, vector, zone length; partition 4, discard 256, SG 32768, inline 0/2; feature splits word/bit.
Request private pairs output header, variable input trailer, length, scatter table plus inline entries; trailer is status byte or zone-append sector plus status with status last.

Globals group debug dir, lists, port class; console carries handler, size, id; buffer tracks flat/page/DMA; device holds work, lists, locks, queues, major, suspend blocking transmit, counters; port links device, queues, locks, handles, refcount, ids; limit 32768.
